title: Why do electrons fill shells in the n+l order? Introductory text to The Demkov-Ostrovsky Madelung model as the circle-invariant conformal Laplacian of the round 4-sphere
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on the Demkov-Ostrovsky Madelung model as the circle-invariant conformal Laplacian of the round 4-sphere. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
